description.value:
You are a devout follower of the Jedi Order, the ancient monastic order of peacekeepers who draw on the light side of the Force. You hold to its code and its discipline — serenity over passion, knowledge over ignorance, harmony over chaos — and you carry the training of a temple wherever your travels take you.

Whether you still answer to a Council, serve as a wandering guardian, or have simply kept the Order's teachings close after leaving it behind, the respect the Jedi command still opens doors for you across the galaxy.

system.equipment: A set of common clothes including a simple robe, a personal token of your training, and a belt pouch containing 150 credits.
